messages:
Alex: Quick sync — Datadog + HW partner observability playthrough tomorrow 10am PT. Can we confirm owners for recording + staging infra? cc @Maria @Ben
Maria: I can own the staging infra. Who has the DD dashboard template?
Ben: I have a draft. Will push a gist in a bit. It includes a trace view + GPU utilization panel. Need the OTLP config snippet from Sam.
Sam: Posting OTLP snippet for staging deploy:
```
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "https://ingest.datadoghq.com:443"
    headers: { "DD-API-KEY": "[REDACTED]" }
service.name: redwood-inference
resource_attributes:
  hw.serial: "{{HOST_SERIAL}}"
  model.version: "v1.3.0"
```
Also: set `sampling.probability` to 0.1 for the demo so we capture example traces without blowing quota.
Alex: Nice. Ben + Maria please verify panel names match our telemetry contract. Also, can dd-bot generate a demo API key scoped to staging?
dd-bot: created demo key `redwood-demo-202405` (expires in 7d). Link: https://app.datadoghq.com/api-keys/xxxx
Ben: Got it. I'll update dashboard JSON. Quick question: do we want to include an example trace that shows automatic prefix/KV caching? Might be too internal for the partner demo.
Maria: Include 1 sanitized sample trace, yes. Ops wants alerts for inference latency > 200ms p95 and GPU memory > 90%.
Alex: Can marketing coordinate recording? We need 3-min explainer + 10-min demo. Sam, can you run the demo steps and confirm stable in staging?
Sam: Will run tonight and post results. If anything fails, check `kubectl logs -n staging inference-rt-0` and the OTLP agent logs.
Ben: Pushed dashboard JSON gist: https://gist.github.com/ben-infra/abcdef. Panels: trace latency, token throughput, GPU mem/temperature, service map.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll import and sanity-check. Added monitor queries: APM p95 > 200ms, GPU mem > 90%.
Alex: Timeline: staging dry-run tonight (Sam), recording tomorrow 11am PT, embargo until Thurs EOD. Who drafts joint blog?
Ben: I can draft. Need concise feature bullets from Product: batching, KV cache, smart routing, marketplace availability + security notes.
Maria: I'll export sample logs and a small synthetic dataset for demo (sanitized).
Sam: Dry-run note: need a small change to OTLP sampler to ensure streaming spans are captured for long responses. Will raise PR.
Alex: Thanks — if anything blocks, ping here. Sam, please attach PR link once up.
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/otel-config/pull/432 — adjusts sampling and adds `hw.serial` resource attr. Testing now.
dd-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing review scheduled with Datadog partner PM at 2024-06-15T17:00Z.
Alex: :rocket: Great. Closing loop — owners: staging infra = Maria, dashboard + blog draft = Ben, demo run + PR = Sam, recording = Marketing (TBD). Ping this thread for any last-minute blockers.
